CORE_JOSIE_RECOVERY.description: Minimum durable state needed to restore Josie operation.

FULL_DATA_RECOVERY.description: Core recovery plus bulk archives and large durable material.

discovery.method: enumerate configured remotes, branches, and tags

categories.verification_method: clone an independent copy, enumerate refs, and run documented tests
categories.restore_method: clone or fetch from a verified independent copy
categories.notes: The working tree is not a backup; private remote coverage is UNVERIFIED.

discovery.method: approved state metadata inventory without opening database contents

categories.verification_method: integrity-check an isolated consistent restored copy
categories.restore_method: restore a consistent backup in a later approved procedure
categories.notes: Production data is excluded and no database path is asserted.

discovery.method: inventory versioned configuration and secret-file presence metadata only

categories.verification_method: hash non-secret files; verify only presence/access metadata for secrets
categories.restore_method: restore non-secrets and inject secrets interactively from approved escrow
categories.notes: No passwords, keys, tokens, or secret values belong in evidence.

categories.verification_method: metadata and checksum comparison on an authorized isolated copy
categories.notes: Delegation receipts and locks are excluded from this preparation task.

discovery.method: inventory versioned policy and approved credential references

categories.verification_method: hash non-secret policy; Dustin performs non-disclosing recovery proof
categories.restore_method: restore policy and recover credentials through attended approved mechanisms
categories.notes: Never print or paste secret values.

discovery.method: read-only Docker availability and volume-name metadata

categories.verification_method: later restore approved archives into isolated new volumes
categories.restore_method: restore into isolated volumes before separately authorized promotion
categories.notes: Preparation never copies, mounts, changes, or inspects volume contents.

discovery.method: read-only drive metadata and attended recovery review
paths: UNVERIFIED Windows recovery media and exports

categories.verification_method: compare inventory with Dustin physical mapping and recovery attestation
categories.restore_method: recreate only in a later attended recovery
categories.notes: No services, firewall, tasks, execution policy, or host configuration are changed.

discovery.method: attended storage mapping and approved metadata inventory

categories.verification_method: compare coverage, byte counts, and sampled hashes after core recovery
categories.restore_method: restore after core operation by dependency and value
categories.notes: Locations, size, throughput, and rebuildability remain UNVERIFIED.

discovery.method: Dustin physically identifies an independent encrypted target

categories.verification_method: physical attestation and separately approved isolated proof
categories.restore_method: attach and unlock interactively in a later approved procedure
categories.notes: Preparation performs no external write and assumes no target exists.
